what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Jamaica in the United States: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 5184 Jamaican asylum seekers in the United States, 68.7% of all asylum seekers from Jamaica.
Refugees from Jamaica, a separate group, live mostly in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom and Germany.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Jamaica, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2023 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2000 at 58 asylum seekers.
The figure was at its highest, 7451, at the end of 2024, and was lower at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in the United States.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for the United States only.
